fields.description:
## Outcome and context

Emily's feedback confirms BAs should log into Salesforce using a WagerTech email address, not a personal or agency email. BUILD-221 (WAGR-186) already documented the wider BA user setup runbook (Rep External ID, Rep Slug, manager, WT Rep permission set group) but didn't address the email/login domain itself.

## Current state

The BA user setup runbook (BUILD-221) sets Rep External ID, Rep Slug, Manager, and the WT Rep permission set group for each new BA User record. It does not currently specify what email address is used for login, and BUILD-203 (BA-2) confirmed there's no separate Login Email field — Primary Email doubles as the login email.

## Proposed solution

1. Confirm the process for WagerTech to issue or provide a WagerTech email address for each BA before their Salesforce User record is created.
2. Use that WagerTech email address as both the User record's login/username and the BA's Primary Email.
3. Add this step to the BA user setup runbook (BUILD-221) so it isn't missed on future BA onboarding.

## Acceptance criteria

1. New BA User records are created with a WagerTech email address as login.
2. The BA user setup runbook reflects this requirement as a standard step.

## Dependencies

Related to BUILD-221 — Brand Ambassador user setup runbook (WAGR-186) and BUILD-203 — Brand Ambassador: Contact & Payment Fields (WAGR-182).

## Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), reviewed Sep 2026: "BA - do we want them to have wagertech email addresses for salesforce login? — Yes." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ShxHdE6kxblGnih7VQzXbBx1eL0sC6XAD-fk8H6V9yw/edit?tab=t.0
